verdict.rationale: Mercury's built-in AI assistant Command is documented to bulk-assign GL codes and do 'categorization in bulk', so the product itself offers AI-driven bulk operations. The documented scope is narrow (categorization and GL coding), the programmatic API and MCP layer are only promised 'soon', and the openapi probes returned 404. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond categorization/GL codes, a shipped programmatic or agent (API/MCP) path for bulk actions, documented limits or batch behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Use Mercury Command to bulk assign GL codes, create categorization rules, and more
